name: The Fool
upright_meaning: New beginnings, innocence, spontaneity, a free spirit setting out on a journey with open heart and no fear.
reversed_meaning: Holding back, recklessness, taking foolish risks, ignoring good counsel.
numerology: 0 — unlimited potential, the void before creation, all and nothing

name: The Magician
upright_meaning: Willpower, skill, and the ability to manifest desires. All tools are available; it is time to act.
reversed_meaning: Manipulation, untapped potential, deception, poor planning.
numerology: 1 — pure will, individuality, the first act of creation

name: The High Priestess
upright_meaning: Intuition, sacred knowledge, divine feminine, the subconscious mind. What you seek lies within.
reversed_meaning: Secrets, disconnection from intuition, information withheld, surface-level knowledge.

name: The Empress
upright_meaning: Abundance, fertility, the natural world, creative growth, nurturing energy. Life flourishes around her.
reversed_meaning: Creative block, dependence, neglecting self-care, smothering others.
numerology: 3 — creation, expansion, the fruit of union

name: The Emperor
upright_meaning: Authority, structure, a solid foundation. The father figure who brings order and protection through discipline.
reversed_meaning: Domination, inflexibility, loss of control, abuse of power.
numerology: 4 — stability, foundation, the four walls of the world

name: The Hierophant
upright_meaning: Spiritual wisdom, religious beliefs, conventional institutions, traditional values. A guide through established systems.
reversed_meaning: Rebellion against tradition, new methods, personal belief over doctrine.
numerology: 5 — change through structure, the mediator between worlds

name: The Lovers
upright_meaning: Love, harmony, relationships, values alignment, choices. A union built on mutual respect and authentic connection.
reversed_meaning: Disharmony, imbalance, misaligned values, a difficult choice avoided.
numerology: 6 — harmony, responsibility, the choice that defines

name: The Chariot
upright_meaning: Victory through discipline and willpower. Opposing forces controlled and directed toward a single goal.
reversed_meaning: Lack of direction, aggression, no self-control, scattered focus.

name: Strength
upright_meaning: Inner strength, courage, patience. Taming raw instinct through love and compassion rather than force.
reversed_meaning: Self-doubt, inner weakness, loss of control, raw aggression.
numerology: 8 — power, cycles, the lemniscate of eternal return

name: The Hermit
upright_meaning: Soul-searching, introspection, solitude. The lantern held high illuminates the path forward for oneself and others.
reversed_meaning: Isolation, loneliness, withdrawal from the world, refusal of inner work.
numerology: 9 — completion, wisdom distilled, the mountain top

name: Wheel of Fortune
upright_meaning: Cycles of life, a turning point, fate and fortune. What goes up must come down — and rise again.
reversed_meaning: Bad luck, resistance to change, clinging to the past, external forces resisted.
numerology: 10 — the completion that begins again, destiny

name: Justice
upright_meaning: Truth, fairness, and the law of cause and effect. Actions have consequences; balance will be restored.
reversed_meaning: Unfairness, dishonesty, lack of accountability, a rigged system.
numerology: 11 — balance, judgment, the mirror of action

name: The Hanged Man
upright_meaning: Voluntary surrender, a pause that grants new perspective. Sacrifice now yields wisdom later.
reversed_meaning: Stalling, martyrdom, paralysis, refusing the necessary sacrifice.

name: Death
upright_meaning: Transformation and endings. Something must die for something new to be born. Resist nothing.
reversed_meaning: Fear of change, stagnation, clinging to what no longer serves, resisting transition.
numerology: 13 — death and rebirth, the unlucky number that creates

name: Temperance
upright_meaning: Balance, moderation, and the alchemical blending of opposites. Patience flows toward purpose.
reversed_meaning: Imbalance, excess, lack of long-term vision, discord in the mix.

name: The Devil
upright_meaning: Bondage to material things, the shadow self, addiction, and the chains we choose. But the chains are loose.
reversed_meaning: Releasing limiting beliefs, exploring dark side, detachment from materialism, breaking free.
numerology: 15 — the inversion of the divine, base matter

name: The Tower
upright_meaning: Sudden upheaval, a lightning strike of truth that destroys false structures. Painful but necessary revelation.
reversed_meaning: Avoiding necessary change, a disaster narrowly escaped, delayed upheaval, fear of change.

name: The Star
upright_meaning: Hope, renewal, and inspiration after the storm. The universe provides; you are guided and loved.
reversed_meaning: Hopelessness, despair, lack of faith, disconnection from one's guiding light.

name: The Moon
upright_meaning: The realm of illusion, fear, and the subconscious. The path forward is unclear; trust feeling over logic.
reversed_meaning: Releasing fear, unhealthy obsessions, confusion begins to clear, illusions seen through.
numerology: 18 — reflection and illusion, the hidden truth

name: The Sun
upright_meaning: Joy, success, vitality, and clarity. Full light illuminates the truth; life is good and growing.
reversed_meaning: Temporary depression, ego, delayed success, inner child suppressed.

name: Judgement
upright_meaning: A moment of reckoning and awakening. The trumpet calls — hear it. Evaluate, forgive, rise.
reversed_meaning: Self-doubt, refusing the call, harsh self-judgment, an ignored inner voice.

name: The World
upright_meaning: Completion, integration, and achievement. The journey is complete; you have arrived whole.
reversed_meaning: Incompletion, shortcuts, loose ends, seeking closure that eludes.
numerology: 21 — total completion, the sum of the journey

name: Ace of Wands
upright_meaning: A new spark of inspiration, a fresh start full of creative potential. The hand of the universe extends the wand — take it.
reversed_meaning: Delays, lack of motivation, creative block, a missed opportunity.
numerology: 1 — pure potential in the fire suit

name: Two of Wands
upright_meaning: Planning and looking toward the future with vision and confidence. The world is held in your hands.
reversed_meaning: Fear of the unknown, lack of planning, staying in the comfort zone too long.

name: Three of Wands
upright_meaning: Expansion, foresight, and the first fruits of effort. Ships come in; your plans are now in motion.
reversed_meaning: Delays, unexpected obstacles, disappointing results, plans that did not travel well.

name: Four of Wands
upright_meaning: Celebration, homecoming, and community harmony. A milestone reached; the flowers are hung and the people gather.
reversed_meaning: Lack of support, transition, instability at home, a celebration incomplete.
numerology: 4 — stable foundation in fire — joy built to last

name: Five of Wands
upright_meaning: Competition, conflict, and opposing forces. The sparring may be productive — or destructive. Channel it.
reversed_meaning: Avoiding conflict, inner struggle, all-out warfare with no resolution.

name: Six of Wands
upright_meaning: Victory and public recognition. The laurel wreath is earned; ride forward with confidence.
reversed_meaning: Egotism, private victories unacknowledged, fall from recognition, need for external validation.

name: Seven of Wands
upright_meaning: Standing your ground against opposition. You hold the high position; defend it with courage.
reversed_meaning: Giving up, being overwhelmed, excessive defensiveness, paranoia about threats.

name: Eight of Wands
upright_meaning: Swift action, rapid movement, and things falling into place. Momentum is yours — don't hesitate.
reversed_meaning: Delays, frustration, miscommunication, momentum lost or misdirected.

name: Nine of Wands
shadow_keywords: giving up at the last hurdle
upright_meaning: Resilience and the courage to continue. Battle-worn but not broken — one final push remains.
reversed_meaning: Exhaustion, giving up near the finish line, excessive defensiveness, paranoia.
numerology: 9 — near completion, the final test in fire

name: Ten of Wands
upright_meaning: A heavy burden carried toward completion. The weight is real but the destination is close.
reversed_meaning: Inability to delegate, a crushing burden, martyrdom, burning out before the finish.
numerology: 10 — completion burdened, fire at its heaviest

name: Page of Wands
upright_meaning: Enthusiasm, exploration, and the free spirit of a new beginning. A message of inspiration arrives.
reversed_meaning: Immaturity, lack of direction, unreliable promises, ideas without follow-through.

name: Knight of Wands
upright_meaning: Fearless action, adventure, and forward movement. Charge toward the goal with fire and confidence.
reversed_meaning: Recklessness, scattered energy, hot temper, acting before thinking.

name: Queen of Wands
upright_meaning: Courage, confidence, and magnetic energy. She knows what she wants and inspires everyone around her.
reversed_meaning: Jealousy, demanding nature, selfishness, volatility in passion.

name: King of Wands
upright_meaning: The natural-born leader with vision and bold energy. He builds empires from sparks.
reversed_meaning: Arrogance, high expectations, impulsiveness, an overpowering presence.

name: Ace of Cups
upright_meaning: A new emotional beginning, the purest offer of love, intuition, and spiritual connection. The cup overflows.
reversed_meaning: Blocked emotions, repressed feelings, emotional emptiness, a creative drought.
numerology: 1 — pure potential in the water suit

name: Two of Cups
upright_meaning: Unified love, mutual attraction, and a deep partnership. Two cups raised in genuine connection.
reversed_meaning: Broken communication, tension, imbalance in relationship, a connection strained.

name: Three of Cups
upright_meaning: Celebration, friendship, and community joy. Come together and raise a cup with those who love you.
reversed_meaning: Overindulgence, gossip, exclusion, or a triangle dynamic straining a friendship.

name: Four of Cups
upright_meaning: Contemplation, apathy, and a moment of withdrawal. A cup is offered from the universe; will you see it?
reversed_meaning: Missed opportunity, total withdrawal, depression, refusing to engage with what is offered.

name: Five of Cups
upright_meaning: Grief and disappointment. Three cups spilled — but two still stand behind you. Loss is real; so is what remains.
reversed_meaning: Moving past grief, accepting loss, finding what still stands after the spill.

name: Six of Cups
upright_meaning: Nostalgia, childhood memories, and innocent joy. A reunion or return to simpler, happier times.
reversed_meaning: Living in the past, naivety about the present, inability to grow beyond old patterns.

name: Seven of Cups
upright_meaning: Fantasies, illusions, and an abundance of options. Beware wishful thinking — look clearly at each cup.
reversed_meaning: Illusion seen through, alignment, making a choice after confusion, returning to reality.

name: Eight of Cups
upright_meaning: Walking away from what no longer fulfills. The cups are stacked neatly — you leave them behind for something deeper.
reversed_meaning: Aimless wandering, avoiding necessary change, fear of commitment to a new path.

name: Nine of Cups
upright_meaning: The wish card. Contentment, satisfaction, and emotional fulfillment. The cups are full and displayed with pride.
reversed_meaning: Greed, dissatisfaction, overindulgence, smugness about achievement.

name: Ten of Cups
upright_meaning: Divine love and emotional fulfillment. The family rejoices beneath the rainbow arc of cups — all is well.
reversed_meaning: Shattered ideals, broken home, misaligned values, a surface harmony that hides dysfunction.

name: Page of Cups
upright_meaning: Creative sensitivity and intuitive messages. A fish leaps from the cup — the unexpected speaks.
reversed_meaning: Emotional immaturity, escapism, creative blocks, daydreaming without grounding.

name: Knight of Cups
upright_meaning: The romantic knight arrives with charm, imagination, and a cup held forward. A proposal or invitation of the heart.
reversed_meaning: Moodiness, unrealistic expectations, jealousy, a promised arrival that doesn't come.

name: Queen of Cups
upright_meaning: Compassionate, emotionally intelligent, and deeply intuitive. She holds the closed cup — she feels what cannot be seen.
reversed_meaning: Emotional insecurity, codependency, manipulating through emotion, moodiness.

name: King of Cups
upright_meaning: Emotional mastery and compassionate authority. He sits on the turbulent sea, perfectly balanced, offering wise counsel.
reversed_meaning: Emotional manipulation, volatility, repressed feelings, a leader who cannot hold his waters.

name: Ace of Swords
upright_meaning: Mental clarity, a breakthrough, and the triumph of truth. The sword cuts through the fog.
reversed_meaning: Confusion, chaos, a breakthrough delayed, or truth wielded without compassion.
numerology: 1 — pure mental force, the first cut of clarity

name: Two of Swords
upright_meaning: A stalemate, willful blindness, and an impossible choice. The swords are crossed; the eyes are covered.
reversed_meaning: Indecision broken, truth unavoidable, lies exposed, a decision finally made.

name: Three of Swords
upright_meaning: Heartbreak, sorrow, and grief. Three swords pierce the heart — feel it fully. Only then can it heal.
reversed_meaning: Recovery from grief, moving on, releasing pain, or wallowing longer than necessary.

name: Four of Swords
upright_meaning: Rest, recovery, and contemplation. Lay down your weapons; the body and mind require stillness to continue.
reversed_meaning: Restlessness, burnout, inability to rest, stagnation masking as rest.

name: Five of Swords
upright_meaning: Conflict and hollow victory. The swords are gathered but at what cost? Not every battle should be won this way.
reversed_meaning: Moving past conflict, releasing the need to win, reconciliation, or unresolvable conflict.

name: Six of Swords
upright_meaning: Moving from turbulence to calmer waters. The swords are carried in the boat — burdens travel with you but the destination is better.
reversed_meaning: Stuck in turbulence, unable to move on, carrying too much baggage.

name: Seven of Swords
upright_meaning: Strategic thinking, cunning, and sometimes necessary deception. He carries five swords away — but two remain.
reversed_meaning: Coming clean, caught in deception, or a strategy that backfires.

name: Eight of Swords
upright_meaning: A self-imposed prison. Eight swords surround the blindfolded figure — but she is not bound to the ground. The restrictions are mental.
reversed_meaning: Moving past restrictions, seeing clearly, self-rescue, or deeper paralysis acknowledged.

name: Nine of Swords
upright_meaning: Anxiety and sleepless nights. The nine swords hang above — they are thoughts, not blades. The suffering is real but the source is the mind.
reversed_meaning: Moving past despair, a mental health crisis, hopelessness that must be addressed.
numerology: 9 — the anguish before completion in air

name: Ten of Swords
upright_meaning: A painful ending. Ten swords in the back — catastrophic, final, and brutal. But the dawn rises on the horizon.
reversed_meaning: Recovery, survival, an ending processed, the worst now behind.
numerology: 10 — the most complete defeat in air — before the dawn

name: Page of Swords
upright_meaning: Curious, sharp-minded, and eager for information. The Page holds the sword high with restless mental energy.
reversed_meaning: Gossip, all talk without follow-through, cynicism, or manipulation with words.

name: Knight of Swords
upright_meaning: Driven, ambitious, and charging forward with mental clarity. He moves fast — perhaps too fast.
reversed_meaning: Recklessness, no empathy, burning through people with blunt force, impulsive decisions.

name: Queen of Swords
upright_meaning: Clear-minded, direct, and independent. She has lived and learned; her perceptions are razor sharp and her boundaries unambiguous.
reversed_meaning: Cruelty, coldness, bitterness from past wounds, harsh judgment without compassion.

name: King of Swords
upright_meaning: Intellectual authority, clear thinking, and ethical power. He holds the sword of truth and wields it justly.
reversed_meaning: Tyranny, power misused, manipulation through intellect, cold and calculated cruelty.

name: Ace of Pentacles
upright_meaning: A new financial opportunity, material abundance, and the seed of prosperity. The hand extends the golden coin — take it with intention.
reversed_meaning: Missed opportunity, financial setback, greed, or material goals without spiritual grounding.

name: Two of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Juggling priorities with adaptability and grace. The infinity loop keeps the coins in motion — balance is the skill.
reversed_meaning: Overwhelmed by demands, disorganized, financial instability, losing the juggle.

name: Three of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Collaboration, mastery, and the satisfaction of skilled work. Three minds work together; the cathedral rises.
reversed_meaning: Lack of teamwork, mediocrity, disorganization, cutting corners on quality.

name: Four of Pentacles
shadow_keywords: hoarding at the cost of living
upright_meaning: Security and stability through careful holding. But the coins clasp body and soul — at what point does security become a prison?
reversed_meaning: Greed, miserliness, financial blockage, or the release of too-tight control.

name: Five of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Material hardship and spiritual poverty. The stained glass window glows with warmth — but two figures pass it in the cold.
reversed_meaning: Recovery from hardship, spiritual support found, refusing available help, the worst passing.

name: Six of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Generosity and the flow of resources. The merchant weighs carefully before giving — fairness is the foundation of generosity.
reversed_meaning: Strings attached, conditional giving, debt, power imbalance in charity.

name: Seven of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Pausing to assess the long-term investment. The vines grow with care — not every harvest comes quickly.
reversed_meaning: Impatience, poor investment, lack of reward for effort, giving up before the harvest.

name: Eight of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Diligent skill development and mastery through dedicated practice. The craftsman works — one pentacle at a time.
reversed_meaning: Perfectionism paralysis, no ambition, repetitive work without growth, missing the big picture.

name: Nine of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Abundance earned and enjoyed in solitude. She stands in her garden of accomplishment — self-made and richly rewarded.
reversed_meaning: Financial dependence, false success, isolation from achievements, overworked for status.

name: Ten of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Legacy, lasting wealth, and multigenerational security. The family gathers — the foundation was built to endure.
reversed_meaning: Family dysfunction, financial failure, a legacy broken, inheritance without meaning.
visual_symbols: ten pentacles in Tree of Life pattern

name: Page of Pentacles
upright_meaning: The practical dreamer who manifests slowly and carefully. The pentacle is held with wonder and intention.
reversed_meaning: Procrastination, learning without applying, lack of practical progress, missed opportunity.

name: Knight of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Methodical, reliable, and deeply hardworking. The horse stands still — the work is the journey.
reversed_meaning: Boredom, perfectionism, no spontaneity, lazy in the face of needed effort.

name: Queen of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Nurturing, practical, and abundantly grounded. She tends the garden of life with warmth and material wisdom.
reversed_meaning: Materialism, over-protectiveness, financial insecurity, or neglecting self for others.

name: King of Pentacles
upright_meaning: The self-made king of material success. He sits amid his empire with steady confidence — provider, builder, protector.
reversed_meaning: Stubbornness, materialism without soul, financial corruption, security without generosity.
